_readme: The goddess who brought Sam over (js/logic/goddess.js, docs/GODDESS.md). Numbers are in balance.json → goddess.
Placeholders: {goddess} her name, {sam}, {house}, {partner} (first name), {past} (Sam's past life, lowercase), {lady} (a lady's first name), {n}, {names}, {cycle}, {skill}.
Any text field may be a list: one entry is picked at random.

rebirth: at every New Game+ before the binding. fast/steady/slow = how quickly he paid (weeks vs the plan). lovers/alone = lovers carried or none. jealous.low/mid/high by her jealousy. bound.low/mid/high = after the binding, by her divinity.

teases: her scenes before the binding, picked by evGoddess (the first unseen eligible one in file order 75% of the time, else a random repeat). Fields: id, title, text, choices [{label, res, love, jealousy, energy (Sam's), reveal}], minCycle, maxCycle, form ('disguise' = random non-true form, 'true' = her own form, or a form key), repeat (filler, may recur, never marked seen), unknown (only before Sam has worked it out), needKnows (only after), reveal (taking the event, or a choice with reveal, sets g.knows), image {comp, setting, sam, pov} (comp describes pose/scene only: the code adds her look). Placeholders: {alias} the name she gives in this form, {form} e.g. 'a fox-eared girl', {race}, {goddess} (only when he knows / true form). Phases: stranger (cycles 1-2, st_*), suspicion (2-3, su_*), reveal (3), game (3-5, gm_*, after the reveal) and true-form scenes (3-5, tr_* and inside/almost/question). She never lets Sam finish: that would bind her.
remarks.low/mid/high: short jealous remarks (by jealousy) as weekly events, from cycle `remarksFrom` (3) on; remarkChoices are their default answers.

binding: the first rebirth after a lady has lived a fully reincarnated life; she confesses it was never a whim. focus: her weekly guidance options (report lines; indulge has feminine/futa variants, chosen by her form setting). claim: what she does when jealousy wins. night: Sam's action on her tab (image, open by divinity low/mid/high, then inside / outside / unhappy lists by how the night ended; {act} = the service label, lowercase). ending.stay/leave: full divinity again.

intro: cycle 1, before the Vane welcome. Her remarks about houses, partners and Sam's past lives live with them: economy.json → houses[id].goddess, pasts[k].goddess {intro, again}; characters.json → partner.goddess {hand, comment}. Her lines with the ladies are services.json → pair.fem/futa; on nights with Sam she uses the usual private-time lines (flavor.json → private_act).
neglect: report lines when Sam stays away (balance.json → goddess.neglect).

look: what never changes, so she's always recognizable: hairStyle, hair, eyes, skin, signature, outfit. forms[key]: one per race and beastkin sub (race, sub, build, body; label for the tab; alias = the name she gives when disguised; desc = how Sam first sees her). trueForm = her own form (story scenes, rebirths). Each form has its own image id (npc_goddess_<key>), so pictures are saved per form.
name: Seliora
title: the Lamplighter
tabBlurb: Goddess of crossings and kept flames, currently bound to a former {past}, glowing a little less than she used to and not entirely sorry about it.

intro.title: Before the truck stops ringing

image.comp: a radiant goddess with a glowing bronze skin and a small ember-flame at her shoulder, sitting in a dark void lit by hundreds of hanging paper lanterns, looking down with an amused smile, one hand extended
image.setting: an endless dark space full of floating paper lanterns

intro.open:
The horn is still ringing when the dark fills up with lanterns. Hundreds of them, hanging from nothing.

A woman sits among them as if on a swing, barefoot, a little ember-flame drifting lazily around her shoulder. Her skin glows from within like a lantern, gold markings brightening at her collarbones and hips as she looks Sam over, slowly, head to toe, like someone deciding what to unwrap first.

"Sam Takahashi. Thirty-one years of being nice to people and nobody ever once being nice back on purpose." She tilts her head. "I'm {goddess}. I light the way across, for the ones I pick. I picked you. On a whim, mostly. Don't read into it." She smiles like a woman who is reading into it a great deal.
intro.close:
"There's a debt. There's always a debt, it keeps you honest. Pay it, and if you're still interesting, I'll bring you back and we'll do it again." She trails one fingertip down his chest, leans close enough that her warmth fills the dark, and doesn't kiss him. "I'll be watching. Everything. Give me something worth watching."

The lanterns go out, one by one.

When he wakes, the lanterns slip away like a dream, and by the time he's tying his shoes there is only a warm smell of candle smoke, and a faint feeling of having forgotten something that mattered.

rebirth.title: Again, {sam}?

image.comp: a radiant goddess with glowing bronze skin and a small ember-flame at her shoulder, lounging on a crescent of lantern-light, chin on her hand, smiling down, dress slipping off one shoulder
image.setting: an endless dark space full of floating paper lanterns

open:
The lanterns again. {goddess} is lying on her stomach across a crescent of light, chin in her hands, feet kicking idly, her dress slipping off one shoulder and no effort made to fix it.

"Debt paid. Look at you." She looks him over, unhurried. "Come here and let me see what the work did to you."

Darkness, then the warm smell of candle smoke. {goddess} is waiting, sitting on nothing, legs crossed, the little ember-flame circling her shoulder like a pet. "There he is. My favorite investment." She crooks a finger.

"Welcome back." {goddess} doesn't look up from the lantern she's turning in her hands. Inside it, very small, is the house he just left. "You did it again. I watched all of it. All of it, {sam}. You have no idea how much I enjoyed some of those nights."
fast: "That was quick. Show-off." She sounds pleased anyway. "I do like a man who gets the job done."
"Paid early. Marguerite nearly smiled, did you see? I had money on it. Now you owe me a kiss."
steady: "Right on schedule. Reliable. It's a good look on you." Her eyes drift down and back up. "Mostly."
"Not fast, not slow. You're very consistent, {sam}. I like a man with stamina."
slow: "That went right down to the wire. I had to watch through my fingers." She doesn't say which fingers she was using.
"You cut that close. Do you know how boring the afterlife paperwork is? Don't make me do it. I'd rather be doing you." She doesn't even pretend to have misspoken.
lovers: "And you're taking {names} with you." A pause that lasts slightly too long. "Of course you are. I hope they appreciate what I've been doing to keep you in such good shape."
"{names}. Again." She counts on her fingers and stops before she runs out. "Sweet. Do tell me everything later."
alone: "Nobody coming along this time? Hm." She looks like she wants to be disappointed for you and can't quite manage it. "More of you for me, then."

low: "Go on, then. Have fun. Tell me about it after."
"Enjoy yourself." A smile. "I will be, vicariously."
mid: "There are a lot of them now, {sam}." She says it lightly. She's looking at the lanterns, not at him.
"You know they don't remember me? Only you do. I find that very fair. Mostly."
high: She catches his chin before he goes and holds it, thumb against his lip. "Every life, more of them. I brought you here. Remember that."
"I counted them. I didn't mean to. I count everything I'm not allowed to have." Her hand slides down his chest, and lingers.

close:
She kisses two fingers and presses them to his forehead, then, after a thought, to his mouth. The lanterns go out.

When he wakes, the lanterns are already fading like a dream, and he can't quite remember whose face was looking down at him.
"Off you go." She flicks his nose, then smooths a hand down his front like she's checking the goods. The dark folds up like paper. The dream is going already; by morning it'll be gone.
"Don't keep me waiting." She almost sounds like she means something by it. Then the lanterns go out. He wakes with the taste of candle smoke and nothing else.

low: This time there are no lanterns. {goddess} is just there when he wakes, warm against his side, mortal-tired, one leg thrown over his. "Again," she mumbles into his neck. "I'm coming too. Obviously."
mid: {goddess} wakes him by pressing close, glowing brighter than last time, the little ember-flame bobbing over her shoulder. "Another life. I'm getting some of it back, you know. Mostly thanks to you. Don't let it go to your head." She kisses him to make sure it does.
high: {goddess} is already up, glowing faintly, watching him sleep with her chin on her hand. "Nearly whole again," she says when he opens his eyes, and slides closer. She doesn't say what happens then.

knows: "You remember," {goddess} says, before he's finished opening his eyes. She's grinning, and a little teary, and doesn't bother to hide either. "Each time you wake up you forget a bit less. Good. I like being known." She pulls him close by the collar. "Now come here, and let me remind you what you've been missing."

"Hello, {sam}. Don't say it, I know: you knew it was me the whole time." {goddess} is lounging across the dark, eyes half-lidded, thoroughly smug. "You're getting good at this. Go on. Go and pay your debt, and I'll find a new face to tease you with." She trails a fingertip down his chest and stops, exactly where she always stops.

teases.title: A stranger at the bar

image.comp: a girl sitting very close to a man at a bar counter, her hand on his thigh, leaning in to whisper in his ear, teasing smile
image.setting: the bar of a lantern-lit pleasure house at night

teases.text:
The girl at the end of the bar isn't a guest and isn't staff, and she's been watching Sam over the rim of her glass for ten minutes. {form}, very long black hair, gold at the tips, eyes that catch the lamplight a little too well.

"{alias}," she says, when he finally goes over, as if he'd asked. "You're the owner. You look like you haven't sat down since the morning." She hooks a foot around his stool and pulls it closer. "Sit. Let someone look after you for once."

She does, for an hour: a hand on his knee, a thumb along his jaw, a laugh against his ear. Then he looks down at his drink, and when he looks up again the stool is empty and the glass is still warm.

choices.label: Look for her
choices.res: He checks the hall, the stairs, the street. No one. The stool is still warm, and he's still wound up tight as a spring. This world is strange.

choices.label: Shrug it off
choices.res: A lucky night, wasted. He tells himself these things happen. In this world, apparently, they do.

teases.title: A visitor in the night

image.comp: a girl sitting on the edge of a man's bed at night leaning in for a kiss, her hand under the blanket, candle-light

teases.text:
Sam wakes because the room is warm. Someone is sitting on the edge of his bed: {form}, black hair spilling over her shoulders, gold tips glowing faintly in the dark.

"Shh. I'm {alias}. You didn't hear me come in." She leans down and kisses him, slow and very thorough, one hand sliding under the blanket to rest on his stomach. He's too startled to do anything but kiss back. Her hand drifts lower. Lower. And the bed is empty, the door is shut and locked, and the room is cold.

choices.label: Kiss her back
choices.res: He catches the last of it before she's gone, and lies awake for an hour, aching. Somewhere far off, someone laughs, pleased.

choices.label: "Who are you?"
choices.res: "Someone who likes you," says the dark, amused, from nowhere. "Goodnight, {sam}."

teases.title: Between the shelves

image.comp: a girl pressing a man back against shelves in a dim storeroom, kissing his neck, her hand at his belt

teases.text:
Sam is fetching linens from the storeroom when the door clicks shut behind him. {alias}, {form}, is leaning against it with her arms behind her back, looking him over like a shopkeeper's window.

"You work too hard." She pushes him back against the shelves and presses against him, warm and close, her mouth at his throat, her hand finding his belt. "Let me help."

He's gasping, nearly there, when a knock sounds outside. "Sam? Are you in there?" He turns his head. When he turns back, the storeroom is empty, and the door is open a crack.

choices.label: Follow her out
choices.res: The hall is empty. A single gold hair is caught on his collar. He picks it off and stares at it for a while.

choices.label: Stay and collect himself
choices.res: It takes a while. The blushing lasts longer. A strange girl, a locked door and a convenient knock. This place is wild.

teases.title: Hot water

image.comp: a girl sitting behind a man in a steaming bath, her arms around his chest, teasing smile, steam
image.setting: a steaming wooden bath at night, lanterns

teases.text:
The bath is already hot when Sam gets in, and already occupied. {alias} settles in behind him, wraps both arms around his chest and hooks her chin over his shoulder. She's {form}, and there is nothing at all between her skin and his back.

"Breathe," she murmurs, hands wandering. They know exactly where they're going, and exactly when to stop. "That's all you get tonight."

He turns his head to answer and the water is just water, rippling gently around him, and the steam smells faintly of candle smoke.

choices.label: Lean back into her
choices.res: He leans into nothing, and the water holds him warm and still. He comes out of it oddly rested, and extremely frustrated.

choices.label: Turn around
choices.res: He turns around fast enough to splash. No one. A ripple of laughter lingers somewhere near the ceiling.

teases.title: The long way home

image.comp: a girl pushing a man against an alley wall, kissing him, her thigh between his, her hand inside his shirt
image.setting: a lantern-lit back alley at dusk

teases.text:
Sam is walking back from the market when a hand takes his wrist and pulls him into an alley. {alias}, {form}, pushes him against the wall with a grin and kisses him until his knees go. Her thigh slips between his; her fingers are inside his shirt.

"Do you always walk home alone?" she whispers. "Someone should do something about that." Her hand moves, and moves, and he's almost, almost, almost-

Then a cart rattles past the mouth of the alley, and when it's gone he's standing there alone, breathless, with his shirt untucked and the faint sense that he's been teased on purpose.

choices.label: Chase after her
choices.res: Nobody in the alley, nobody in the street. He walks home with his coat held in front of him.

choices.label: Laugh it off
choices.res: This world runs on strange luck. The kind that gets you kissed in an alley and then leaves you shaking. He's not sure whether that's good or bad luck.

teases.title: A stranger sits down
teases.text: A girl sits down next to Sam, uninvited: {form}, with very long black hair and gold-tipped ends. "{alias}," she says, and holds out a hand he doesn't get to shake. She lays it on his thigh instead, and talks about nothing for ten minutes while her fingers draw slow patterns higher and higher. Then she excuses herself to 'fix her hair', and doesn't come back.

choices.label: Chase her
choices.res: You can't catch a woman who isn't there. He heads back to work with a very foolish smile.

choices.label: Let her go
choices.res: He finishes his drink and then, after a while, gets up. Whoever she was, she left him with a very flushed face and no way to tell anyone why.

teases.title: A wink in the crowd
teases.text: In the middle of a busy evening, {alias} is just there: {form}, hip against the counter beside Sam, slipping one hand into his pocket and out again with a coin he hadn't known he had. "Tip," she says. She tucks it into his collar, brushes her lips against his ear, and her hand lingers at his waist just a moment too long. By the time the crowd shifts she has gone.

choices.label: Chase her
choices.res: You can't catch a woman who isn't there. He heads back to work with a very foolish smile.

choices.label: Let her go
choices.res: The coin is warm. It's also gold, and it's gone by morning.

teases.title: Someone is watching
teases.text:
The back stairs are dim, and someone is waiting at the top of them: {form}, long black hair, gold tips, lit from within. {alias} takes the lapels of his coat and walks him backward into the wall, kissing him with a hunger he can feel in his spine. Her knee presses. His breath breaks.

"Later," she promises, and slips out of his hands like smoke.

choices.label: Chase her
choices.res: You can't catch a woman who isn't there. He heads back to work with a very foolish smile.

choices.label: Let her go
choices.res: The stairs are empty, the lamp flickers, and Sam stays there for a long moment, one hand against the wall.

teases.title: The same hair

image.comp: a girl perched on the corner of a desk, crossing her legs, leaning in to run a finger along a man's tie, teasing smile

teases.text:
It's {alias} again: {form}, a different girl, with a different name and a different pair of ears. Sam is at the desk when she perches on the corner of it, crossing her legs slowly, and asks how his night is going.

He's looking at her hair. Very long. Black. Gold at the tips, glowing faintly. The last girl had the same. And the one before that.

"Something wrong?" She leans in, smiling, and runs a finger along his tie. "You're staring."

choices.label: "Have we met?"
choices.res: "Haven't we all?" She taps his nose and kisses him on the corner of the mouth, and the door clicks, and she is not there. The pattern is getting hard to ignore.

choices.label: Say nothing, but watch her eyes
choices.res: Gold. Glowing. Exactly the same gold. She notices him noticing, and her smile grows slow and pleased. She's gone before he can ask.

teases.title: Always the same
teases.text:
Sam has made a list. It's a short, embarrassing list: a fox, a cat, an elf, a dwarf. Each one a stranger, each with the same hair, the same eyes, the same warm bronze skin, and each one gone just before he-

He's staring at it when {alias} comes in, {form}, and reads it over his shoulder. "What's this?"

"A coincidence," he says, and she laughs, pressing herself against his back, her hands sliding around his waist. "Poor thing. You've been so frustrated."

choices.label: "You know exactly why."
choices.res: "Do I?" Her breath on his neck is hot enough to hurt. "Maybe I'm just a bad girl. Maybe you're just unlucky." She nips his ear. The door closes behind nobody.

choices.label: "Stay. Please."
choices.res: "Oh, I'd love to." She does, exactly until he's about to say something clever. Then he's alone with his list.

teases.title: Questions

image.comp: a girl in a man's lap in an armchair, his hands on her wrists, her face close to his, a finger against his lips, teasing

teases.text:
Sam is done being teased in silence. When {alias} appears, {form}, slipping into his lap with an easy smile, he catches her wrists.

"Who are you?"

"{alias}. I told you." She wriggles. Her hips do something distracting. "Ask a better question."

"Why do you always leave before-"

"Ah." She presses a finger to his lips. "Wrong question too. Try again in a few lives." She kisses him instead of answering, very thoroughly, and he does not notice the 'lives' until much later.

choices.label: "Few lives?"
choices.res: She goes very still for half a heartbeat. "Did I say lives? I meant weeks." She slips out of his hands, laughing, but she's not quite meeting his eye.

choices.label: Kiss her back, and let it go
choices.res: He lets it go, and spends an hour lying awake going over the word.

teases.title: Smoke and candle
teases.text:
Sam can't stop thinking about the dream. Gold lanterns, hundreds of them. A woman, laughing. Every time he reaches for the details, they slide away. But when {alias} comes through the door, {form}, and he smells candle smoke, he knows exactly where he's smelled it before.

She tries to kiss him. He turns his head.

"What's wrong?" Her smile slips for a heartbeat. "You're being strange."

"You smell like lanterns," he says.

choices.label: Hold her wrists, gently
choices.res: "Sam." Her voice is small. "Not yet." She presses her forehead against his chest for three long breaths. Then she's gone, and for the first time, he thinks she wanted to stay.

choices.label: Pull her in and ask again
choices.res: "Don't." She kisses him to stop him, and it's a worse kiss, more frightened. She slips away. He is nearly sure now.

teases.title: Another one
teases.text: {alias}, {form}, is already sitting on the stairs when Sam comes up, ankles crossed, glowing faintly. "You're late." She pulls him down beside her and kisses him, a warm lazy kiss, one hand tucked inside his shirt. "Didn't you miss me?" She's gone before he's finished deciding, leaving him with the gold hair on his sleeve and an uneasy thought.

choices.label: Call after her
choices.res: "Whoever you are..." His voice carries down the empty hall. No answer. But the candles flicker, and he thinks he hears a laugh.

choices.label: Smile and say nothing
choices.res: He holds the hair up to the lamp. Black, tipped with gold, and exactly like all the others.

teases.title: Her eyes, again
teases.text:
Sam finds himself watching a girl's eyes: {alias}, {form}, who has appeared, as they always do, in the middle of a quiet hour. Glowing gold. She catches him at it and her smile deepens. She walks him to the wall, slow, and he lets her. "Looking for something?" she asks, and her hand slips into his waistband.

He doesn't get to answer.

choices.label: Call after her
choices.res: "Whoever you are..." His voice carries down the empty hall. No answer. But the candles flicker, and he thinks he hears a laugh.

choices.label: Smile and say nothing
choices.res: Gold. Always the same gold. He is counting now.

teases.title: Different ears, same girl
teases.text: {alias} has new ears today, {form}, and the same everything else. She walks around him in a slow circle, trailing a hand across his shoulders. "What do you think? Do I suit it?" He thinks he's on to her. He thinks he's missing something, too. By the time he can say any of it, the chair beside him is empty.

choices.label: Call after her
choices.res: "Whoever you are..." His voice carries down the empty hall. No answer. But the candles flicker, and he thinks he hears a laugh.

choices.label: Smile and say nothing
choices.res: He sits there for a minute, then goes and checks the mirror in the hall. Nothing in it but him.

teases.title: Say my name

image.comp: a girl in a man's lap, arms around his neck, forehead to his, a startled and delighted look, candles flaring around them
image.setting: Sam's bedroom at night, every candle burning gold

teases.text:
She comes to him as {alias} tonight, {form}, with a smile that is a little too wide. She sits in his lap, loops her arms around his neck, and he lets her. He lets her all the way to the edge of the kiss.

Then he says, quietly, "{goddess}."

Everything stops. Her smile stays where it is; her eyes don't. The candles dip. He doesn't know where the name came from: a dream of paper lanterns, a woman swinging in the dark, a promise about a debt. It was just there on his tongue.

"...Well," she says, in a voice that isn't {alias}'s anymore. "That took you long enough."

choices.label: "You've been teasing me for years."
choices.res: "Lives," she corrects, and kisses him, laughing and furious and relieved, all at once. "You remembered. You actually remembered. Don't stop." She stays a good long while this time.

choices.label: "Why the disguises?"
choices.res: "Because the game is more fun when you don't know the rules." She presses her forehead to his. "And because I was afraid you'd say no, once you knew. Foolish of me." The glow around her brightens, a little shy.

teases.title: New rules

image.comp: a girl straddling a man on a bed, hands on his chest, a wicked smile, looking down at him

teases.text:
{goddess} arrives as {alias} tonight, {form}, hands on her hips, with the air of someone about to read terms and conditions.

"So you know. Which is a nuisance, because the disguises are fun and I'm not giving them up." She walks around him in a slow circle. "New rules. I come as someone new. You can play along, or you can call me by my name and I'll punish you. Either way, you don't finish. That part doesn't change."

"Is that a rule or a punishment?"

"Yes."

choices.label: Play along
choices.res: "Good," says {alias}, with a slow, wicked smile, settling into his lap as if she'd been introduced for the first time. The game is terrible, and wonderful.

choices.label: "Nice to meet you, {goddess}."
choices.res: "Oh, you're going to pay for that." She pushes him back onto the bed and makes him, thoroughly, until he's begging. She never gives him what he's begging for.

teases.title: Introductions
teases.text:
{alias}, {form}, knocks on the office door and waits to be asked in, an act which is not at all like her.

"Good evening. I'm new in town." She holds out a hand, perfectly innocent. "I heard the owner could use some help." Her eyes are glowing gold and entirely innocent. Her hand is already inside his coat.

"You haven't introduced yourself," Sam says, and she gives him a look that says play along or suffer.

choices.label: "Welcome. What can you do?"
choices.res: "Oh," says the stranger, "a great many things." She shows him a few. All of them. None to completion. He is going to be walking funny for a while.

choices.label: "{goddess}, you're a terrible actress."
choices.res: "I'm a wonderful actress and you are a spoilsport." She hits him with a pillow, then kisses him. Then, it turns out, there's more than one pillow. Somehow, it still leaves him frustrated.

teases.title: Wrong pretext

image.comp: a girl wearing glasses and carrying a stack of books, leaning over a man seated at a desk, her hand on his shoulder, playful smile

teases.text:
The knock on the door is very polite. {alias} is standing outside in {form}, carrying a stack of books, wearing a pair of spectacles she definitely doesn't need.

"Mr. {sam}? I'm here about the private lesson." She's trying very hard not to laugh. "I understand it's... hands-on."

She is not subtle. He does not mind. Forty minutes of 'lessons' later, he's learned that a goddess in spectacles is considerably more dangerous than one without, and that she has no intention of giving him the final exam.

choices.label: Insist on a retake
choices.res: "No retakes," she says, smugly, tying her hair back. "Fail, learn, repeat." She kisses his forehead on the way out, which is somehow the worst part.

choices.label: Beg for extra credit
choices.res: "Begging. Good start." She's glowing with satisfaction. She doesn't award extra credit.

teases.title: A new face, an old game
teases.text: Tonight she's {alias}, {form}, lounging across his desk and pretending very hard that they haven't met. "I'm sure I'd remember a man like you," she says, as her foot slides up the inside of his thigh. He plays along. She's very good. She's also absolutely merciless, and leaves him exactly one breath from the edge.

choices.label: Call her by name
choices.res: "Seliora." Her mask slips, just a little, and she's smiling so wide he can feel it. "Good boy." She kisses him, and doesn't let him finish.

choices.label: Stay in character
choices.res: "Until next time," she says. "Remember my name." She leaves it unsaid, which is part of the game.

teases.title: Pick a name
teases.text:
{alias}, {form}, is waiting in the hall. "Guess," she says, and wraps herself around him. "Go on. I'll give you a point for every correct answer." He guesses 'Seliora' on the first try. She gives him a point. The point is one very pointed kiss.

The game goes on a good deal longer than he'd like. It ends the usual way.

choices.label: Call her by name
choices.res: "Seliora." Her mask slips, just a little, and she's smiling so wide he can feel it. "Good boy." She kisses him, and doesn't let him finish.

choices.label: Stay in character
choices.res: She leaves laughing, a little breathless, a little pleased with herself.

teases.title: Playing a part
teases.text: Tonight {alias} is {form}, shy and sweet and clumsy, tripping into his arms and not apologizing. "Oh, I'm so sorry," she says, in a voice that has never been sorry in its life, and the way her hands wander is not at all clumsy. It ends the way it always does, and he's very nearly proud of how much he is able to take.

choices.label: Call her by name
choices.res: "Seliora." Her mask slips, just a little, and she's smiling so wide he can feel it. "Good boy." She kisses him, and doesn't let him finish.

choices.label: Stay in character
choices.res: "Don't pout, {sam}," she calls over her shoulder. "Good things come to those who wait."

teases.title: Herself

image.comp: a tall goddess with glowing skin sitting on the edge of a man's bed at night, hair loose, leaning in for a slow kiss, candle-light and a floating ember-flame

teases.text:
For the first time in a very long time, {goddess} comes to him as herself. No ears, no tail, no wings: just a tall, bronze, glowing woman with eyes the color of lamp-flame, sitting on the edge of his bed with her hair loose over her shoulders.

"I got tired of being someone else," she says. "For tonight, at least." She leans down and kisses him, slow, and he feels the tremor in her. "Tell me what you remember."

choices.label: "The lanterns. And you."
choices.res: She closes her eyes. "Good," she whispers. "That's the part I wanted you to keep." She stays with him until he sleeps.

choices.label: "Not enough."
choices.res: "Then I'll tell you." She does, a little at a time, in the dark, between kisses. She doesn't tell him all of it.

teases.title: Counting
teases.text:
{goddess} is waiting in Sam's room with her arms folded, every candle burning an offended, sulky orange.

"{n}. {n} of them." She doesn't say of what. "Tonight you're mine. Don't argue, I'm a goddess."

She pulls him down onto the bed and keeps him there all night: close, closer, never all the way, her hands and mouth making very sure he won't forget whose bed this is. She never once lets him finish.

choices.label: "You could just stay."
choices.res: She goes very still. "No," she says. "I couldn't." Then, quieter, into his shoulder: "It wasn't a whim, you know. Forget I said that." She stays until dawn anyway.

choices.label: Tell her she's the only goddess
choices.res: "That's a technicality," she says, pleased, and bites his ear.

teases.title: Not yet

image.comp: a goddess on top of a man in bed at night, gold markings blazing, one hand pressed to his chest to hold him still, intense look

teases.text:
This time she doesn't stop at the edge. She takes him in, slow, eyes closed, gold markings blazing along her hips, and for a moment the whole room is lantern-light, every flame bowing toward them.

Then her hand is flat on his chest. "Stop. Stay. Don't." Her voice isn't steady. "If you finish in me I'm yours. Not as a figure of speech. And I've wanted you for far longer than you know." She stays exactly like that, holding them both on the edge, until she can let go of him without either of them breaking.

choices.label: Hold still for her
choices.res: He does. It is the hardest thing he has ever done. Afterwards she lies on his chest for a long time and doesn't disappear.

choices.label: "Would that be so bad?"
choices.res: "For a goddess? Catastrophic." She kisses him. "Ask me again later."

teases.title: Edges
teases.text:
{goddess} visits more often now and leaves later. She takes him all the way in and stops, every time, at the very last moment, with a sound like it costs her more than it costs him.

"You know what I'd lose." Her forehead against his. "Everything I am. And I'd be yours. I watched you for years before the truck, you know. Years. I don't even know which of those scares me more."

choices.label: "I'd give it back."
choices.res: She laughs, shakily. "You'd try. You're very stubborn." She doesn't say no.

choices.label: Kiss her until she stops thinking
choices.res: It works for a while. At dawn she's still there, which is new.

teases.title: What if
teases.text:
{goddess} sits on the windowsill, glowing faintly, the ember-flame dozing against her neck, looking at the house.

"One of them has done it all now, you know. Lived and lived again, as far as a life can carry." She doesn't look at him. "You fed that stray cat every morning for two years and nobody ever saw. I saw. It wasn't a whim, Sam. It never was." She finally turns. "When you bring her back next time, I'm coming too. I don't think I can watch from the lanterns anymore."

choices.label: "Then come."
choices.res: "Next time," she says. "Finish what you started." Then she's gone, and the window is only a window.

choices.label: "You're sure?"
choices.res: "No." She smiles, crooked. "Goddesses are never sure. We just act like it."

low: A warm draft rattles the shutters. A voice, amused: "{lady}? Cute. You have taste, I'll give you that. Did she make that sound for you? I'd like to hear it again."
Every lantern in {house} flickers at once. Someone giggles. Nobody else hears it.
Sam finds a single small ember on his pillow, still warm, burning nothing. Under it, in a very elegant hand: "Busy week? I enjoyed the show."
mid: "{n} of them now." {goddess} is sitting on the end of the bar, invisible to everyone else, swinging her feet. "I'm not counting. I'm a goddess, I just know." Her toe traces a slow line down his leg.

{goddess} appears in Sam's room the night after he was with someone else. She doesn't say anything. She just sits there glowing at him, pointedly, her dress sliding lower by the minute, until he apologizes for something he can't name.
"{lady} again?" The voice is at his ear, warm and dry, and a hand he can't see settles at his belt. "I'll remember that. I'll want to compare."
high: Every candle in {house} gutters out at once. In the dark, {goddess}'s voice: "I brought you here. I could have picked anyone. Don't make me regret it." The candles relight themselves, one at a time.
{goddess} catches Sam in the hallway, pins him to the wall by the collar and kisses him hard enough to hurt, hands already inside his shirt. "So you remember who was first," she says, and is gone.
"How many, {sam}?" She isn't smiling. Her hand is on his chest, warm and possessive. "How many before you look up?"

remarkChoices.label: Tease her back
remarkChoices.res: Sam tells the empty air it looks lovely tonight. The air flushes gold. That shouldn't be possible.

remarkChoices.label: Reassure her
remarkChoices.res: "You were first. You'll always be first." A long pause. "...Fine," says the dark, mollified.

remarkChoices.label: Let it go
remarkChoices.res: Sam lets it go. Somewhere, a goddess sulks.

binding.title: Bound

image.comp: a goddess and a man embracing in bed, her skin glow fading, gold markings dimming and the ember-flame guttering, lantern-light dying around them, tears and a smile
image.setting: an endless dark space full of floating paper lanterns going out one by one

binding.text:
This time the lanterns don't wait for him to wake. {goddess} is there before the dark is finished, and she doesn't say "again."

"{names} has lived it all now. Everything a life can carry. And so have I, watching you." She pulls him down with her. "I told you it was a whim. It wasn't. Years, Sam. Years of watching you be kind when nobody was looking: the stray cat you fed every single morning for two years, all the little things nobody ever thanked you for. I wanted you the whole time. I'm done watching."

She doesn't stop him this time. She holds on, and when he finishes inside her the light goes out of her like a breath let go: the glow under her skin, the gold markings, the little ember-flame, the warmth that never came from anywhere. Every lantern goes dark at once.

What's left is a woman with gold eyes, shaking, laughing, holding on to him.
binding.after:
"Oh," she says. "Oh, that's cold. Is it always this cold?" She burrows into him. "I'm yours now. All of me, the little that's left. I wanted you since before the truck, and I'd never have said so with the light still on. You'll have to build me back up, {sam}."

She has a tab of her own now. She'll do what she likes each week. You can tell her what you'd like; she might even listen.

indulge.label: Indulge them
indulge.desc: She seeks out the ladies who are most worked up or worn down and takes care of them herself: lust spent, mood and energy back.
indulge.report: {goddess} spent part of the week with {lady}. {lady} came back glowing.
feminine: {goddess} found {lady} restless and took her to bed. {lady} came back glowing and slept like a stone.
{goddess} drew {lady} a bath, got in with her, and didn't get out for hours.
futa: {goddess} chose to take {lady} as something more than a woman tonight. {lady} couldn't walk straight at breakfast and was smiling about it.
{goddess} let {lady} find out what a goddess can be when she feels like it. {lady} has not stopped blushing.

business.label: Business
business.desc: She works the floor of one house: patrons spend more, the house's name grows.
business.report: {goddess} worked the room at {house}. Patrons found themselves in a generous mood.

watch.label: Watch over them
watch.desc: She keeps an eye on the house with the most trouble and stops pushy clients before anyone else has to.
watch.saved: {goddess} stopped {n} pushy client(s) before anyone else had to. They left very politely and won't remember why.

tutelage.label: Tutelage
tutelage.desc: She takes the least practiced working lady as her pupil: job skill and a stat.
tutelage.report: {goddess} tutored {lady} in {skill}. She's a demanding teacher.

whim.label: Her whim
whim.desc: No guidance at all. She does what she feels like, a little more strongly than usual.

sam: {goddess} decided Sam was hers for a night and kept him up until dawn. He has never been so tired or so smug.
{goddess} didn't do what you asked. She dragged Sam to bed instead and wouldn't let go. (Sam's energy −)
lady: {goddess} took the new girl, {lady}, aside for a long, pointed conversation about who was here first. {lady} looks shaken, and oddly flattered.
{goddess} monopolized {lady} all week, half curious and half making a point. {lady} is exhausted.

image.comp: a goddess with faintly glowing bronze skin lying close against a man in bed at night, gold markings softly lit, a small ember-flame floating over them, content smile

low: {goddess} is cold more often than not now, and mortal-tired. She pulls Sam under the covers and against her, skin to skin, and for a while that's all.
"Warm me up," she says, and means it in every way.
mid: There's light coming back into her. Not much: a glow under her skin where he touches her, gold markings flickering awake along her collarbones and hips. She gasps at it every time, like she forgot.
high: {goddess} is almost herself again. The room is lantern-bright when she pulls him down, the candles leaning in. She could stop him now, if she wanted. She doesn't want.

inside: When he finishes inside her, light floods back into her skin, the gold markings flaring and the ember-flame spinning with delight. "There," she breathes, laughing. "That. More of that." A little of the warmth he lost all day comes back into him too.
Afterwards she lies with her ear against his chest, glowing, listening to the heartbeat she chose, and tells him exactly how pleased she is with his {act}. Smug, and radiant.
He finishes inside her and the room goes gold. {goddess} drags him closer by the hair and kisses him through it. "Good {sam}," she murmurs. "Good, good {sam}."
outside: He finishes, but not inside her, and {goddess} is pleased and a little sulky about it. "Considerate. Wasteful." No light comes back, but she traces circles on his chest anyway, and the flame hovers close.
"That was lovely, and I'm still cold." {goddess} nips his shoulder. "Next time, don't be so polite about the {act}."
She watches him finish with open appreciation, and then pouts, prettily, because the light stays out of her. "You know where it's supposed to go."
unhappy: {sam} didn't finish, and {goddess} is deeply put out. "You wasted my night," she pouts, and the candles dim to match her mood. "I wanted the {act} to end properly."
"Nothing? After all that?" {goddess} flops back on the pillow and glares at the ceiling. The ember-flame sulks in a corner. "You owe me. With interest."
{goddess} turns her back to him, arms crossed, skin dimming. "Wake me when you've remembered how it's done," she says, and does not sleep a wink.

stay.title: Whole again

image.comp: a radiant goddess fully glowing again, gold markings blazing, a bright ember-flame circling her shoulder, holding a man's hand on a rooftop at night, lanterns rising into the sky
image.setting: a rooftop at night, hundreds of paper lanterns floating up

stay.text:
It happens on an ordinary night. The light comes back all at once: the glow under her skin, the gold markings, the ember-flame, the warmth from nowhere. {goddess} is a goddess again, entirely.

The lanterns are waiting. She can feel them pulling.

She takes Sam's hand instead. "I could go," she says. "I could pick someone new and watch. That's what I'm for." Her fingers tighten. "I don't want to watch anymore. I'm staying."
stay.res: She stays, whole and divine and his. (Her story is complete. She keeps her full power.)

leave.title: Whole again

image.comp: a radiant goddess fully glowing again, gold markings blazing, an ember-flame at her shoulder, rising into a night sky full of lanterns, looking back over her shoulder
image.setting: a rooftop at night, hundreds of paper lanterns floating up

leave.text:
It happens on an ordinary night. The light comes back all at once: the glow under her skin, the gold markings, the ember-flame, the warmth from nowhere. {goddess} is a goddess again.

She looks at Sam for a long moment. "You gave it all back. Every bit of it." She touches his face. "But you never really asked me to stay, did you."

The lanterns rise, and she goes with them.
leave.res: She's gone. Somewhere, among the lanterns, she's picking someone new. (Her story is over.)

look.signature: a small lantern-flame floating beside her shoulder, faint gold markings along her collarbones
look.outfit: a sheer crimson-and-gold wrap dress held by thin gold chains, barefoot
look.skin: warm bronze that glows faintly from within, like a lantern

neglect.ignored: {goddess} hasn't seen Sam in {n} weeks. She's noticed.
neglect.claim: {goddess} made a scene over another woman and Sam never came to her. That hurt.
